product_line: Generic device facts: NEMA-configuration wiring devices, standard outlet-box sizes, and code / convention mounting heights (vendor-neutral)
license_note: Code / standard FACTS and industry conventions only. Standards text is not reproduced; each entry states the figure and cites the code section. See ../LICENSE_NOTES.md.

collection_posture.summary: These are public code and standards facts (US ADA Standards, NFPA 70 National Electrical Code, NEMA WD 6 device configurations). The ADA reach-range figures and the NEC 4-in-square-box volume were corroborated by search this session; the underlying standards documents were not re-read verbatim, so entries citing them without a direct read are flagged accordingly. Design conventions (typical mounting heights) are 'assumed' by definition - they are firm/project choices within the code envelope, exposed as editable parameters.
collection_posture.method: search corroboration of code figures; conventions from practice

S1.doc: 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design, section 308 (Reach Ranges) and 309 (Operable Parts)
S1.note: 308.2.1: unobstructed high forward reach 48 in (1220 mm) max, low forward reach 15 in (380 mm) min above finish floor - figures corroborated via search summary of the standard text; document not re-read verbatim this session.

S2.doc: NFPA 70, National Electrical Code (NEC), Article 314.16 (box fill) and Table 314.16(A) (metal box volumes)
S2.note: Table 314.16(A) volume of a 4 in x 1-1/2 in square box = 21.0 in^3 - corroborated via search summary; other box volumes below are recalled and flagged 'assumed' until Table 314.16(A) is read directly.

S3.doc: NEMA WD 6 - Wiring Devices Dimensional Specifications (receptacle / plug configurations)
S3.note: Not read this session; NEMA configuration names below are common knowledge, dimensions from WD 6 are not transcribed.

ada_forward_reach_high_max_in.note: ADA 308.2.1 unobstructed high forward reach maximum 48 in (1220 mm) - the CEILING for switch / control operable-part height.

ada_forward_reach_low_min_in.note: ADA 308.2.1 low forward reach minimum 15 in (380 mm) - the FLOOR for receptacle height (to the operable part).

ada_obstructed_reach_high_max_in.note: ADA 308.2.2 obstructed high forward reach 44 in (1120 mm) max where reach depth exceeds 20 in (508 mm), 25 in (635 mm) max depth.

box_4in_square_1_5_deep_volume_in3.note: NEC Table 314.16(A): 4 x 1-1/2 in square box = 21.0 in^3.

variants.role: 125 V, 15 A duplex receptacle (NEMA 5-15R), the default room outlet
variants.dims_note: Envelope of a standard single-gang device box + duplex strap for the family symbol (single-gang device box nominal 3 x 2 in opening, 2-1/2 in deep typical; wall plate 4-1/2 x 2-3/4 in nominal). These are OUR modelling envelope values, flagged 'assumed'.

mounting_height_aff_in.note: 18 in above finished floor to the box centerline is a common design convention (assumed); ADA sets only the 15 in minimum to the lowest operable part (fact).

options.box: single-gang device box or 4 in square box with single-gang mud ring

plate_in.note: OUR modelling envelope of a nominal single-gang wall plate (2-3/4 x 4-1/2 in, ~1/4 in proud of the wall) for the family's faceplate solid - assumed, editable.

unit_load_va.note: 180 VA per receptacle strap (yoke) for load calculation - recalled code figure, flagged 'assumed' until Article 220 is read directly; the family surfaces it as the editable Load parameter.

source.doc: 2010 ADA Standards 308 (reach ranges) - mounting-height envelope; NEMA WD 6 for the 5-15R configuration name

variants.notes: The NEMA 5-15R = 125 V / 15 A / 2-pole 3-wire mapping is standard NEMA WD 6 nomenclature but S3 was not read this session, so it is 'assumed' pending a verbatim read. Only the ADA reach-range envelope (line_facts) is a corroborated fact.

options.box: single-gang device box or 4 in square box with single-gang mud ring

source.doc: NEMA WD 6 configuration naming (not read this session)

variants.notes: All 'assumed' - see 5-15R notes (plate envelope and the 180 VA unit load included).

variants.role: 120/277 V single-pole toggle switch, the default lighting control

mounting_height_aff_in.note: 48 in AFF to the top of the switch operable part satisfies the ADA 308.2.1 48 in unobstructed forward-reach maximum (fact); centering at 48 in is the common convention (assumed).

plate_in.note: OUR single-gang wall-plate modelling envelope (assumed) - same as the receptacles.

variants.notes: The 48 in reach ceiling is the sourced fact (line_facts); device ratings and box envelope are 'assumed' conventions.
